mintAuthority.summary: USDU cannot be minted by users directly; only DAO-approved/whitelisted adapter contracts (Curve, TermMax, Morpho) can mint or burn USDU, and the set of approved adapters is curated under USDU Finance DAO risk governance.

controls.label: Whitelisted USDU adapters (Curve / TermMax / Morpho)
controls.evidence: 2026-07-20 full SetModule/SubmitModule event enumeration from block 0 on the USDU token 0xdde3ec717f220fc6a29d6a4be73f91da5b718e55: 9 module addresses were ever submitted, 4 have since expired. checkValidModule() = true today for exactly these five adapters: 0xfb46481a9819e068af0eb64a2c2824fcecaaaa45, 0x8f36bbee57acb4857cb97898020b529969fdf221, 0x77cbb2f180f55dd2916bfc78f879a2c2de37f638, 0x5febefd5aecfefb3352c5edd49d634b1456c4bd7, 0x397fb4a34757ac180c0841b26131f25040e2e50b. 0xfb46481a… has a never-expiring module grant (expiredAt = 2^256-1); the other four expire 2027-10 (modules() reads). All approvals were submitted by the curator DAO proxy 0x9fe66037c44236c87d9ac8345f489b4413fdff06.

controls.label: USDU DAO / curator (adapter whitelist authority)
controls.evidence: curator() on the USDU token returns this ERC1967Proxy (the curator DAO, implementation behind the proxy), read 2026-07-20. It is the sole submitter of all historical SetModule events and governs adapter approval and risk parameters.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203 the USDU token's curator/guardian/module model was established (curator = 0x9fe66037c44236c87d9ac8345f489b4413fdff06, no guardian set, mintModule/burnModule gated to whitelisted modules). 2026-07-20 follow-up: full SetModule/SubmitModule event enumeration from block 0 found 9 historical module approvals, of which exactly five are currently valid (checkValidModule = true): 0xfb46481a9819e068af0eb64a2c2824fcecaaaa45, 0x8f36bbee57acb4857cb97898020b529969fdf221, 0x77cbb2f180f55dd2916bfc78f879a2c2de37f638, 0x5febefd5aecfefb3352c5edd49d634b1456c4bd7, 0x397fb4a34757ac180c0841b26131f25040e2e50b. The curator DAO proxy resolves to a standard Aragon OSx DAO implementation (0x58c1f7bc62bb63fb137bc8f6d8ea6321a0501d29): module approvals execute through the Aragon permission framework rather than a single EOA. Blockscout's verified direct Stablecoin source exposes the module-gated mint path and curator/guardian transitions, but no proxy or upgrader path; fixed-block EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were zero at Ethereum block 25573280.. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the curator can approve replacement mint adapters without an evidenced independent timelock, while the issuer backing API does not establish whole-supply reconciliation and no prudential supervisor or independent attestor is evidenced. Wave 2 external research reviewed 2026-08-15: USDU's public backing-snapshot API continuously exposes total backing, complete USDU supply, and Curve, TermMax, and Morpho adapter balances for its sole Ethereum deployment; this establishes issuer-operated whole-supply reconciliation, while no independent reserve attestor or prudential supervisor is documented.
